definition.name: H - OPENING RANGE BREAKOUT -> RETEST -> CONTINUATION
definition.opening_range: Exactly completed regular 09:15,09:20,09:25 bars; high=max(high), low=min(low); all three required.
definition.BUY: At/after09:30 completed close>OR_HIGH arms. A strictly later completed low<=OR_HIGH and close>OR_HIGH qualifies. First eligible qualifying candle emits BUY; direction DONE for session.
definition.SELL: At/after09:30 completed close<OR_LOW arms. A strictly later completed high>=OR_LOW and close<OR_LOW qualifies. First eligible qualifying candle emits SELL; direction DONE for session.
definition.no_filters: No RSI/EMA/VWAP/volume filters, tolerances, breakout-distance limits, body thresholds or retest-duration limits. ATR14 is used only by unchanged execution readiness/sizing/stop/target.
definition.skipped_bars: Existing harness semantics: process completed regular skipped bars causally for state; record qualifying skipped retests without emission or backfill. Remain armed until first eligible qualifying retest emits. Entry gates are unchanged. Skipped reasons are reported as HARNESS_SKIPPED (position/risk/readiness not individually inferred).
definition.cutoff: State expires after existing final allowed signal bar (LEGACY15:05, CAS15:00). First subsequent qualifying retest may be recorded as CUTOFF diagnostic only; no new breakout after expiry. Final tail consumed with emission disabled.
definition.funnel: Initial breakout at most once per direction/session before cutoff. Qualifying retests/conversion count distinct armed breakouts with any later qualifying candle (including skipped/cutoff); all candidate candles separately counted. No-qualifying includes no retest through final regular candle. Cutoff-blocked counts distinct breakouts with late candidate. First-retest delays and emitted-retest delays are distinguished.
definition.execution: Unchanged runner/engine: completed N signal, physical regular N+1 open, signal ATR, adverse5bps each leg, stop1.5ATR,target2ATR, gaps first, range STOP wins, sole _close_position, no overlap/overnight.
definition.classification: Zero violations first. N<30 INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE; gross<=0 REJECT. Candidate requires gross>0,net>0,PF>=1,DD<30%,>=10 trades and gross>0 in each half and each policy regime, >=10 trades on both sides with both sides gross-positive, no Phase15 concentration flag. Otherwise positive gross RESEARCH FURTHER. These conservative research gates are frozen before results.
definition.comparison_limit: F has RSI/VWAP/volume entry filters while H deliberately has none. F-vs-H compares complete hypotheses, not an isolated causal effect of retesting. Same dataset informed H: never held-out or production-ready.

interpretation.H classification: REJECT: 127 trades is non-trivial, but gross -INR22,844.07 and PF0.6683 fail the economic gate. Both sides, both chronological halves, and both policy regimes are gross/net negative. No correctness violation or concentration flag.
interpretation.Did retesting improve entry quality or m: Some descriptive improvement beyond frequency: F->H PF0.6124->0.6683, average gross -208.71->-179.87 INR, average net -342.76->-313.29 INR, median confirmed MFE1.4712->1.5500 ATR, pooled1/3/6-bar mean returns improve. But pooled12-bar mean falls from+0.01994% to-0.03552%; median MAE slightly worsens1.1981->1.2073 ATR. Thus short-horizon quality improves modestly, not enough for a positive symmetric economic edge. Filter differences, composition and carried sizing prevent attributing this causally to retest alone.
interpretation.Forward evidence: H pooled1/2/3/6/12-bar mean ATR =0.06266/0.06164/0.06313/0.10347/-0.14305. BUY percentage means are negative at every horizon; SELL is positive through6 bars but negative at12. Positive one-bar BUY ATR mean with negative percent mean reflects different volatility normalization, not a direction-convention error.

interpretation.Time of day: First two entry buckets account for about87.4% of total net loss. The11:30-12:29 bucket is positive (+3,579.28 INR,14 trades); retained descriptively with every losing bucket. No time filter proposed.
interpretation.Costs A or B: A under the canonical gross convention: H loses before explicit charges. Exact fixed-path raw-price accounting +8,023.58 INR less slippage30,867.65 equals gross -22,844.07; explicit charges16,944.10 deepen net to-39,788.17. This is not a positive canonical gross edge destroyed only by fees, nor a zero-slippage backtest. Charges/turnover0.02744637%; charges/absolute gross74.1729%; average fee133.42 INR.
interpretation.Skipped-bar interpretation: The preregistered unchanged-harness semantics were retained. One SELL breakout had skipped qualifying candidates and never emitted; another had a cutoff-blocked retest. No breakout with a skipped first retest later entered in this sample, so consuming versus retaining that missed direction would not change saved H entries here.
interpretation.Selection contamination: H was proposed after Phase16 on this same dataset. All results are exploratory and selection-contaminated; no held-out or production-ready claim. Positive subgroups are not validated alternatives.
interpretation.Recommended next step without tuning: Archive canonical H as rejected. Do not adjust H, remove a side, or filter time buckets. Any further strategy work requires a separately preregistered new economic entry hypothesis and genuinely non-overlapping validation data; this result does not justify tuning H.
